## Purpose

What problem does this change solve, and what changes for the user or contributor?

## Scope

Name the affected component or flow. Link an issue if one exists.
Describe any shared contract or package compatibility change.

## Checks performed

List only checks actually performed, their results, and anything not checked.
For documentation, describe the readback and link checks.
For behavior changes, include relevant commands and observed results.

## Documentation and attribution

Link updated guidance. Identify any third-party material and its license.
Do not include credentials, private tenant data or unredacted logs.
For vulnerabilities, follow SECURITY.md before sharing details.
